name: Broad Enterprise Co.,Ltd.
summary: Broad Enterprise Co., Ltd. provides digital infrastructure for condominium management in Japan. Its offerings are B-CUBIC, a high-speed internet service for apartment buildings, Bro-lock, an IoT-based intercom system that locks main entrances automatically, and Bro-Cloud, a DX platform that equips collective housing with IoT devices. Dating from 2000 with headquarters in Osaka, it is a subsidiary of DI Co., Ltd.
